messages:
From: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@fincloud.de>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Request: multi-region residency architecture deep-dive

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the earlier notes — we're ready to move to a technical readout and demo focused on multi-region deployment and data residency. Our DPO (dpo@fincloud.de) and procurement team will join. Key asks from our side:

- A 60-minute architecture walk-through covering EU data residency options, how Redwood routes between US/EU/APAC, and fallback behavior when capacity is constrained.
- A 30-minute compliance breakout for SOC 2 scoping, data retention options, and audit log evidence.
- A short demo of the model routing and a quick perf summary for 2048-token workloads.

Can you propose 2–3 windows next week (CET preferred) that work for engineering + DPO? Our team is available the week of Dec 7–11 in the mornings CET, but procurement might only make afternoons CET. If needed we can split into two sessions (technical + compliance).

Please cc Karthik if you want sales/contract-level coordination. We'd like to capture the session recording and an artifact (runbook / checklist).

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Schmidt

- Option B: Dec 9, 15:00–16:00 CET (Tech readout) — if procurement needs afternoon — and Dec 10, 09:00–09:30 CET (Compliance)

If you'd prefer to split across two days we can do that; we're fine with either approach. Attached a short pre-demo checklist so we can make the session actionable.

Agenda (draft):
1) 10m — introductions & scope
2) 25–30m — architecture walkthrough (routing, fallback, KV/prefix caching behavior)
3) 15–20m — demo: routing between EU/US/APAC + perf numbers
4) 15m — operational controls (pinning model versions, rollouts, canary, audit logs)
5) 30m — compliance breakout (SOC 2 scoping, data retention, audit evidence)

Can you confirm which option works and who from your side we should include in calendar invites?
